find: Any disqualification must come through legislation enacted by Congress or the House's own power to judge its Members' qualifications, so the order must be reversed.
replace: The State's order must be reversed. The Court's discussion of federal enforcement and Congress's historical practice does not itself decide how the House could exercise its separate power to judge its Members' qualifications.
reason: The five-Justice opinion relied on Section 5 for federal enforcement and cited the House's historical role. The case did not adjudicate an exercise of the House's own constitutional authority.
